observation.command: cat > /tmp/drive3.py <<'PY' import urllib.request, urllib.parse, http.cookiejar, re, json TOKEN="0188ce74d52a937095e833fa93c664044dd81c9781759754d8ee83fbf4b76e99" BASE="http://localhost/qisutu/install.pl" cj=http.cookiejar.CookieJar() op=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj), urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler()) def get(url=BASE): r=op.open(url); return r.geturl(), r.read().decode('utf-8','replace') def post(data,url=BASE): body=urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode() r=op.open(url, body); return r.geturl(), r.read().decode('utf-8','replace') def csrf(html): m=re.search(r'name="CSRFToken" value="([0-9a-f]+)"',html); return m.group(1) if m else None def report(url,html): m=re.search(r'(.*?)',html); print("URL:",url,"TITLE:",m.group(1) if m else '?') for e in re.findall(r'qisutu-install-error[^>]*>(.*?)',html,re.S): print(" ERROR:",re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',e).strip()) return html # set session cookie manually import http.cookiejar as cjmod ck=cjmod.Cookie(0,"QISUTU_SESSION_INSTALL",TOKEN,None,False,"localhost",False,False,"/qisutu/",True,False,None,False,None,None,{}) cj.set_cookie(ck) url,html=get(BASE+"?Step=4"); report(url,html); open('/tmp/s4.html','w').write(html) t=csrf(html) url,html=post({"Step":"4","Action":"SaveSystem","CSRFToken":t,"HTTPType":"http","FQDN":"localhost","WebPath":"/qisutu","AdminEmail":"admin@example.org","DefaultLanguage":"de","Timezone":"Europe/Berlin","TicketHook":"Qisutu","AttachmentMaxSize":"25"}) report(url,html); open('/tmp/s5.html','w').write(html) t=csrf(html) url,html=post({"Step":"5","Action":"SkipMail","CSRFToken":t}) report(url,html); open('/tmp/s6.html','w').write(html) PY python3 /tmp/drive3.py
